name: TradRack
description: TradRack is a multimaterial system for FFF 3D printers with a focus on scalability at low cost. It uses a selector-type design where a single drive gear pair is mounted on a selector carriage riding along an MGN9 linear rail on a 2020 aluminum extrusion frame. The selector moves to each filament lane position and a servo-actuated pivoting arm lowers a hobbed gear onto the filament to engage it. Each additional lane requires only one printed module body and a handful of cheap hardware parts, making it extremely cost-effective to scale.

mechanicalSpecs.bufferType: One buffer per lane (type not specified by official docs)

features: MGN9 linear rail with 2GT belt-driven selector
Extruder syncing support (TradRack as secondary extruder)
Tool mapping and lane groups for runout handling
Supports filament sensors, cutters, purge buckets
Lane count is user-configurable with no fixed maximum
